content:
We are looking for an experienced Network Architect / Solution Architect to provide design leadership and technical documentation for an ADMS Hardware Upgrade Project.
The role will focus on developing network architecture diagrams, defining secure communication paths, drafting firewall rules, documenting IP addressing and hostnames, and conducting network failure-mode analysis to ensure reliability, security, and real-time performance.

🚨 Hiring: Network Architect / Solution Architect | South Plainfield, NJ
🏠 Location: South Plainfield, NJ (Hybrid) Local Candidates Only
🚗 Valid Driver’s License (DL) Required
💼 Contract Position
🎥 Interview: Video
🚫 No H1B

🔑 Top Skills
Enterprise Network Architecture & Design
Firewall Rules & Security Design for OT/IT Environments
Network Documentation & Failure-Mode Analysis
LAN/WAN, Routing & Switching
Network Segmentation, Redundancy & Security Zoning
Mission-Critical / Real-Time Network Environments

✅ Required Qualifications
Proven experience in enterprise network architecture and design.
Strong knowledge of LAN/WAN, routing, switching, firewall design, segmentation, redundancy, and security zoning.
Experience designing networks for real-time or mission-critical operational technology environments.
Strong technical documentation and architecture skills.
Ability to proactively identify technical risks and develop mitigation strategies.

🔧 Key Responsibilities
Develop detailed network and system architecture diagrams for ADMS, OMS, SCADA, DMS, DERMS, and GIS integrations.
Document system processes, network flows, interfaces, and communication paths.
Design and verify firewall rules and secure communication paths for ADMS environments.
Define secure interfaces and architecture standards across OT/IT environments.
Document IP schemes, hostnames, LAN/VLAN segments, routing requirements, and network connectivity.
Identify technical risks, failure modes, and mitigation strategies.
Support failover, redundancy, segmentation, and real-time performance testing.
Ensure network architecture supports outage management, switching operations, reliability, and real-time situational awareness.
Collaborate with Grid Operations, OT teams, SCADA engineers, cybersecurity teams, and vendors.
Clearly communicate technical architecture and risks to technical and business stakeholders.

📩 Interested and comfortable with this position? Please share your updated resume at abhay@sourceinfotech.com
